As our VP of Partnerships, you will own the evolution, centralization, and growth of Tellent’s partner ecosystem, a critical engine that already drives a substantial percentage of our total revenue. This is a high-impact, strategic leadership role. You will take our existing regional partnership structures and unite them into a single, high-performing global organization designed to scale our ARR to the next level.

You are a builder and a strategist who understands that ecosystem growth is about depth, not just breadth. You will shift our focus toward high-yield, quality relationships, evolve our mix toward deep ISV and Marketplace integrations, and build a predictable partner pipeline that matches or exceeds our traditional marketing engine.

You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), lead a dedicated team of 6 across our major geographies, and serve as a core leader in Tellent’s commercial journey.

Your 12-month journey

  • First 3 months: Immerse yourself in our current partner ecosystem across the Benelux, France, DACH, and International markets. Understand our existing revenue contribution, historical channel performance, and product integration landscape. Establish strong relationships with your team and GTM peers (Sales, Marketing, RevOps). Begin designing the transition roadmap from a regional setup to a centralized partnership organization.

  • First 6 months: Successfully execute the centralization of the Partnerships Org. Implement unified KPIs, operational cadences, and governance models across all regions. Begin shifting the partner mix by prioritizing high-potential ISV and Marketplace operators over low-yield referral networks. Introduce a structured framework to measure and accelerate partner-driven pipeline velocity.

  • First 12 months: The centralized Partnerships organization is fully operational and recognized as a predictable, powerhouse engine for Tellent. You have successfully unlocked new revenue streams through strategic marketplace ecosystems, and build a predictable partner funnel pacing toward 20-30%+ of qualified pipeline by month 12, on a path to rival our inbound and outbound engines over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the partner-sourced number: You own the partner-sourced ARR and qualified-pipeline targets, driving the strategic growth plan from FY27 through FY30. As the commercial leader for this motion, you will quarterback the partner-sourced forecast in the CRO’s weekly revenue review, ensuring healthy pipeline coverage, velocity, and conversion.

  • Ecosystem centralization & leadership: Merge regional partnership efforts into a single, cohesive global strategy. Manage, mentor, and scale the team covering Benelux, France, DACH, and International Markets, fostering a culture of high performance and shared best practices.

  • Strategic portfolio optimization: Shift the strategy from volume to value. Audit our current partner network to double down on high-quality, high-potential relationships that maximize revenue funnel and drive sustainable ARR.

  • Channel mix evolution: Strategically transition our ecosystem from traditional reseller and referral models toward robust ISV, developer, and Marketplace operator partnerships that deeply integrate with Tellent’s product suite.

  • Own data infrastructure & attribution: Design and run the model that credits partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue. Architect the tracking frameworks for Stage 2 qualified pipeline, and stand up the supporting PRM and reporting stack in our CRM so partner pipeline is forecast with the same rigour as direct sales.

  • Funnel generation: Build and scale repeatable co-marketing and demand-generation frameworks with partners to unlock a predictable, qualified lead flow that rivals our inbound/outbound marketing funnels.

  • Cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with the CRO, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to ensure our partnership strategy aligns with our product roadmap and broader commercial objectives.

  • Commercial execution: Design commercial frameworks, tiering structures, and incentive programs that motivate partners while protecting Tellent’s margins and unit economics.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercial heavyweight who thinks in terms of ecosystem leverage and predictable revenue architecture. You are not just a relationship manager; you are a strategic operator who knows how to operationalize partnerships to scale a B2B SaaS business.

Must-haves

  • Deep HR Tech SaaS expertise: Significant experience leading and scaling partnerships specifically within the HR Tech SaaS space. You understand the ecosystem, the key players, and buyer behavior in this vertical.

  • Proven leadership in scale-ups: Experience managing international teams and driving organizational change (ideally transitioning from regional to centralized or matrixed structures).

  • Marketplace and co-sell execution: Hands-on experience standing up and scaling marketplace listings (Hyperscaler, or major ISV marketplaces) and structured co-sell motions, not just sponsoring them. You know how the listing, attribution, and joint-pipeline mechanics actually work.

  • Analytical & commercial sharp: Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, net retention, pipeline velocity, LTV/CAC) and how partnerships directly impact them.

  • Mobility & Presence: Willingness and ability to travel regularly across our core European hubs to support your team and key partners.

  • Language: C2 level English. Fluency in French, German, or Dutch is a significant advantage.

Nice-to-haves

  • Existing relationships with major SaaS marketplaces or enterprise HR platforms.

  • Experience working in a multi-hub European model (NL, FR, DE).

  • Familiarity with PRM (Partner Relationship Management) tools and setting up partner attribution models within HubSpot.

What we offer*

  • Compensation range: €115.000 - €140.000

  • OTE: €150.000 - €185.000

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension scheme

  • Access to OpenUp & ClassPass

  • 28 holidays + 2 wellness days

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget

*Benefits can vary based on location

About Tellent

Tellent is a Talent Management Suite that helps organizations attract, hire, manage, and grow their people. Our platform combines Applicant Tracking, HRIS, and Performance Management solutions used by 7,000+ companies across 100+ countries.

With 250+ employees across Europe, we’re building intuitive and scalable HR technology that helps companies create better employee experiences.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

As a Digital Customer Success Manager for the Benelux market, you will partner closely with another Digital CSM to co-manage and retain a critical segment of roughly 1,300 small-to-mid market customers in the Benelux region. Instead of traditional 1:1 management, you will leverage product data, AI, automation, and localized multi-channel outreach to drive product adoption and directly impact Gross Revenue Retention (GRR). This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity for an operations-minded self-starter to test, roll out, and iterate digital initiatives in a dynamic growth-stage SaaS environment.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You will get to know the team, the products, and our customer dynamics. You'll join customer calls, master Tellent's digital CS tools, and manage select, high-value reactive customer requests to build baseline product empathy, always with the goal of translating these patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

  • Within 6 months: Spearhead the end-to-end design, localization, and rollout of a critical digital program (such as onboarding or churn-prevention) in Benelux market. You will partner actively with Account Managers to translate data-driven usage trends into concrete renewal and upsell opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You have truly left your mark on our digital customer journey! By building and scaling programs that measurably increase product adoption, you have turned your ideas into standard operating processes and established yourself as a key driver of Tellent's long-term retention.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Customer Success at Scale: Proactively guide and safeguard the segment using scalable, one-to-many communication rather than traditional relationship-heavy 1:1 management.

  • Drive Digital Adoption & Retention Programs: Develop, roll out, and iterate on digital programs utilizing channels such as email, in-app banners, chats, videos, and webinars, primarily tailored for our Benelux audience.

  • Analyze Customer Data & Insights: Regularly monitor Benelux segment retention, adoption, and engagement metrics to proactively identify patterns, target silent or low-engagement accounts, and measure campaign effectiveness.

  • Surface Growth & Expansion Signals: Monitor regional usage signals to identify and qualify upsell or cross-sell opportunities, passing these actionable leads directly to the local AM team.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with your peer Benelux Digital CSM, local Account Management, Support, Ops, Product Marketing, and Product to scale customer outcomes and launch seamless digital workflows.

What You Bring

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch (minimum C1 level or higher) and English (minimum B2 level or higher).

  • Confident Customer Engagement: Experience in customer-facing roles with a proven ability to drive outcomes through your interactions. You have no stage fright, genuinely enjoy engaging with strangers, and feel right at home presenting a webinar in both Dutch and English.

  • A Systems Mindset: Natural process-oriented thinking; you enjoy organizing chaotic workflows, look for ways to scale your work, and are comfortable working with data, dashboards (like Metabase), and pattern-spotting. Experience with systems like Planhat, HubSpot, and Intercom is highly valued.

  • Self-Starter: An entrepreneurial mindset with a natural drive to innovate. You proactively seek out answers independently, experiment with solutions, and don't wait for a manual to make processes run better.

  • Adaptability: You thrive in an environment that is not heavily predefined and are excited by the opportunity to help design and build new processes from scratch.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our canal-side Amsterdam office

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days in 2026

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

Join the team behind Tellent HR, our HRIS platform trusted by thousands of companies to manage the HR processes they rely on every day—from time off and attendance to employee data. These are business-critical workflows where reliability, scalability, and a great user experience matter.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a key role in evolving our platform while working alongside a collaborative product squad of engineers, a Product Manager, and QA.

We're looking for a product-minded Senior Backend Engineer. Engineering depth is the job, but you'll ask \"why?\" before building, challenge requirements that don't serve the user, and work with your squad to find the best solution—not simply implement what's written in a ticket. You'll help shape technical decisions while partnering closely with your team to deliver real customer value.

Your primary focus will be backend development in Node.js, with occasional opportunities to contribute to our React frontend when it helps deliver the best customer experience. We value engineers who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable stepping outside their primary area of expertise when needed.

Your First Year at Tellent

First 3 months: You'll get to know the team, our product, and the Time Off domain, where you'll begin contributing to improvements that thousands of customers rely on every day. Supported by experienced teammates, you'll become familiar with our architecture, engineering practices, and ways of working while shipping your first meaningful improvements.

Within 6 months: You'll take shared ownership of key parts of the product, contribute to technical decision-making, review code, and help spread knowledge across the team. Working closely with your squad, you'll improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability while helping shape the future of the platform.

After 1 year: You'll be a trusted technical partner within the team, driving improvements, contributing to architectural discussions, and helping teammates succeed through collaboration, mentorship, and knowledge sharing. Success at Tellent is built together, and we value engineers who elevate those around them as much as the solutions they build.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve core HR workflows in Node.js, working on rules-heavy domains where correctness and reliability are essential (for example, country-specific time-off policies).

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services used by organizations of all sizes.

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of existing features as our customer base continues to grow.

  • Refactor and modernize our platform while ensuring a seamless experience for existing customers.

  • Occasionally contribute to frontend development in React when it helps deliver the best customer experience.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, QA, and designers to solve customer problems and deliver valuable product improvements.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing, helping raise the engineering bar across the team.

What You'll Bring
